module_docs.content_excerpt:
# Pulp command line interface

This is a command line interface for Pulp 3.

This software is in beta and future releases may include backwards incompatible changes.

Check out our [docs](https://docs.pulpproject.org/pulp_cli/) and the
[quickstart guide](https://pulpproject.org/pulp-cli/docs/user/guides/installation/#tldr-get-started-real-fast) to get started.

25: def strategy_semver(requirement: Requirement, latest_version: Version) -> Requirement | None:
26:     requirement = Requirement(str(requirement))
27:     upper_bound = None
28:     rest = []
29:     for spec in requirement.specifier:

31:             if upper_bound is not None:
32:                 if Version(spec.version) > Version(upper_bound.version):
33:                     rest.append(upper_bound)
34:                     upper_bound = spec
35:                 else:
36:                     rest.append(spec)
